name: Nalu Vida
facts: Nalu Vida is at 1 Washington Blvd, Venice, CA 90292, at the foot of the Venice Pier.
Phone: (310) 437-0060. Email: info@naluvida.com. Instagram: @naluvidavenice.
Hours: Mon-Thu 11 AM-12 AM, Fri 10 AM-2 AM, Sat 9 AM-2 AM, Sun 9 AM-12 AM.
Brunch is served daily until 4 PM, with $24 bottomless mimosas (60 min).
Happy hour is Mon-Fri 3-6 PM and 10 PM-close, dine-in only.
Parking: the public beach lot next to the pier, plus street parking.
Book a table on Resy. A 20% gratuity is added for parties of 6 or more.
Private events: parties of 10 to 100. The tour is free and so is your drink.
Joining Nalu Vida Rewards is free. One account per person.
You earn 10 points per $1 on eligible purchases, before tip.
Join bonus: +100 points once. Birthday bonus: +250 once a year.
Referral: +100 points for each friend who joins with your code and makes a first visit.
Ride the Nalu: every 100 game score = 1 rewards point, up to 50 game points a day.
Rewards: 250 pts, 500 pts, 1,000 pts ($20 off your check) and 1,500 pts (a free entree up to $33).
One reward per member per day. A reward pass works once and expires after 10 minutes.
Rewards never include free alcohol, have no cash value and can't be transferred.
Nalu Vida has its own points balance, separate from Melody Bar & Grill.
The weekly Ride the Nalu board is for bragging rights only. The game gives no prizes.
Burger Mondays, Taco Tuesday, $2 oysters on Wednesday, NFL Sunday.
Events: trivia Mon, acoustic Tue, live jazz Thu, karaoke Fri, block party and blues on certain Saturdays.
Order from your phone by picking Patio, Bar, Dining room or Rooftop, or by scanning a table code.
You pay your server or bartender like normal.

qa.q: What time do you open on weekends?
qa.a: Saturday and Sunday we open at 9 AM. Saturday closes at 2 AM and Sunday at 12 AM.

qa.q: How do I plan a private event?
qa.a: Tap the Plan an event button in the app, or email info@naluvida.com.
info@naluvida.com.
@naluvidavenice on Instagram. The app also has a section with our posts.

Monday through Friday, 3-6 PM and again from 10 PM until close. Not offered on weekends.

qa.q: Is happy hour available at the bar and takeout?

qa.q: What food is on happy hour?

qa.q: What drinks are on happy hour?
qa.a: $10 house margarita, wells, house red and white, Prosecco, and $2 off drafts. We don't have a price listed for wells, so ask staff.
The Today's special card in the app shows what's on today. The weekly list is: Burger Mondays, Taco Tuesday, $2 oysters Wednesday and NFL Sunday. Brunch is daily.
Mondays have $9 burgers and a $5 draft beer special, from 5 PM to close.
Tuesdays signature tacos are 50% off all day, plus $10 house margaritas.
Wednesdays are Shuckin' Good Wednesday: $2 oysters (minimum 6), while supplies last.
NFL Sunday: every NFL game is on the TVs, with bottomless mimosas. We open at 9 AM.
Yes, brunch is served daily until 4 PM, with $24 bottomless mimosas (60 minutes).
They're $24 and last 60 minutes. They're for guests 21+ with ID, and available during brunch (until 4 PM).

Mon: trivia 7-9 PM and Monday Night Football. Tue: acoustic 8-11 PM. Thu: live jazz 6-9 PM and Thursday Night Football. Fri: karaoke 9 PM-close. Sun: NFL Sunday. Check the Events this week section for more.
Mondays, 7-9 PM.

qa.q: What sports can I see live scores for?
qa.a: NFL, college football, NBA, MLB, NHL, MLS, WNBA, college basketball and UFC. Tap Live scores in the app.

qa.q: Can I follow my favorite team?
qa.a: Yes, the Live scores section lets you follow teams, and it has an LA teams tab.

qa.q: Can I pick game winners in the app?
qa.a: The scores section has a pick-the-winner feature. It doesn't pay points.

qa.q: How do I join Nalu Vida Rewards?
qa.a: Tap the Rewards section in the app and join. It's free. One account per person.
Yes, joining Nalu Vida Rewards is free.

qa.q: Do I need an account to play the game?
qa.a: No. You can play Ride the Nalu with or without an account. Join the same day to save your game points.

qa.q: What do I get for joining?
qa.a: +100 points once, when you join.
You earn 10 points per $1 on eligible purchases, before tip. You can also earn a join bonus, a birthday bonus, referral points and game points.

qa.q: How many points do I get per dollar?
qa.a: 10 points per $1 on eligible purchases, before tip.

qa.q: How many points do I earn per visit?
qa.a: There's no flat per-visit amount. You earn 10 points per $1 spent. The 'Add my visit' step is how you claim them.

qa.q: How do I get my points after I eat?
qa.a: Tap Add my visit in the app, then snap your receipt or type the check number, total and date (today or yesterday).

qa.q: What are the rules for Add my visit?
qa.a: One receipt per member per day, each check only once, up to $150 per check. Claims are checked against the restaurant's sales report, and points from made-up checks are removed.

qa.q: Do I earn points on tax and tip?
qa.a: No, points are on eligible purchases before tip. We don't have a list of non-eligible items, so ask staff.
Yes. Once Toast is connected, earning becomes automatic and your points carry over.

250 pts: free mocktail, soft drink or Jungle Fries. 500 pts: free shareable (Chips, Salsa & Guac, Calamari, Wings or Sticky Tiki Ribs). 1,000 pts: $20 off your check. 1,500 pts: a free entree up to $33.
A free mocktail, soft drink or Jungle Fries.
A free shareable: Chips, Salsa & Guac, Calamari, Wings or Sticky Tiki Ribs.
$20 off your check.
A free meal: any entree up to $33. That includes Steak & Fries, Tiki Ribs, Blackened Salmon, Seared Ahi, Chicken Milanese, Scampi Skewers, Adobo Chicken or Fish N' Chips.

qa.q: How do I redeem a reward?
qa.a: Tap Use reward, confirm, and a live pass opens. Show it to your server, who applies it. The points come off when the pass opens.

qa.q: How long does a reward pass last?
qa.a: A pass works once and expires 10 minutes after it opens. Each pass has a fresh one-time code, and a used or expired code never works again.

qa.q: Can I use more than one reward a day?
qa.a: No. It's one reward per member per day, and one prize per day total. A second one shows Come back tomorrow.
No. It's one reward per visit, one prize per day, no stacking.

qa.q: Can I get free alcohol with points?
qa.a: No. Rewards are never free alcohol.

qa.q: Do rewards expire or have cash value?
qa.a: Rewards have no cash value and can't be transferred. We don't have an expiry rule listed, so ask staff.
No visit levels. There's one points balance and one rewards ladder (250, 500, 1,000 and 1,500 points).
Yes, +250 points once a year on your birthday.

qa.q: How do I refer a friend?
qa.a: Share your referral code. You get +100 points for each friend who joins with it and makes a first visit.
A friend can enter one code, once, when they join. It can't be changed later and you can't use your own. A referral never stacks with another reward on the same visit.

qa.q: Is there an early-bird or location bonus?
qa.a: Not in the app text we have. Ask staff or call (310) 437-0060 about any current bonuses.

qa.q: Do my Nalu Vida points work at Melody Bar & Grill?
qa.a: No. Each spot has its own points balance, and points don't move between restaurants.
Our sister spot in Westchester, by LAX, from the same owners. It's at 9132 S Sepulveda Blvd, Los Angeles, CA 90045. The app has a link to it.

qa.q: Do I have a digital rewards card?
qa.a: Yes. Open My Rewards Card in the rewards section to see your name, card ID, points and a QR code. Apple and Google Wallet buttons aren't turned on yet.

qa.q: Can I add the app to my home screen?
qa.a: Yes. The app has an Add to Home Screen option with steps for iPhone and Android, so it opens like an app.
It's our surf game on the Venice Pier loop. You paddle out, grab food rafts and ride the wave home across 5 levels. It's free to play and earns rewards points.

qa.q: How do I play Ride the Nalu?
qa.a: Drag left and right to steer. Paddling out, tap DUCK DIVE (or the screen) as each breaking wave reaches you. Riding in, stay off the white foam, tap JUMP to launch off the lip and use TRICK in the air.
Drag left and right to steer. Tap JUMP (or swipe up) to duck-dive or launch off the lip. In the air, tap TRICK or swipe: sideways is a 360, down is a grab, up is a flip.
5 levels. Level 1 is about 2 minutes, and later levels have shorter paddle-outs. Finish all 5 for a big finish bonus.
You score points for rafts, duck-dives, time in the wave pocket, barrel exits and tricks. Hits cost you points or hearts. Keep a streak going for multipliers (4 in a row is x2, 8 is x3).

qa.q: What do the food rafts give?
qa.a: Island Tacos +100, Mimosa +120, Jungle Fries +120, Smash-N-Stack +150 and Coconut Shrimp +150. Rarer rafts may give more.
Duck-dive under waves (+100), dodge the fisherman's harpoon (+150), ride the barrel out the exit (+200), land tricks and keep your streak alive.

qa.q: What hurts me in the game?
qa.a: Paddling out: waves that catch you, stingrays and stray harpoons. Riding in: the white foam (-1/2 heart and -100), the pier and rocks. Landing mid-trick is a light bail (-150, no heart).
You have 5 hearts, lost in halves. At 0 you're out and the run ends. Health kits float by when you're hurt.

qa.q: Is there anything violent in the game?
qa.a: No. Bumping into things is a mild wipeout (a splash, then you pop back up). There are no weapons for you and no boss fights.

qa.q: What is the fisherman and his harpoon?
qa.a: Paddling out you may pass a fisherman hunting a shark. When his orange aim line shows, get off it or duck-dive. A stray harpoon costs a heart, and dodging it is worth +150.

qa.q: How do game points turn into rewards points?
qa.a: Every 100 score = 1 Nalu Vida Rewards point, up to 50 game points a day (Los Angeles date). Reaching the cap takes 5,000 score.

qa.q: What is the daily game points limit?
qa.a: 50 game points a day, on the Los Angeles date. You can still play for fun after that.
As often as you like. It's free, and only the rewards points are capped at 50 a day.

qa.q: I played without joining. Do I lose my points?
qa.a: Points from today are held on your phone. Join the same day to save them.

qa.q: Does the game give prizes or discounts?
qa.a: No. The game gives no prizes, codes or discounts, only rewards points up to the daily cap.

qa.q: How does the weekly leaderboard work?
qa.a: The weekly board is for bragging rights only. It resets every Monday and closes Sunday 11 PM (LA time). Last week's top players show on the champion card.

qa.q: Is there a weekly champion prize?
qa.a: No. The weekly board is for bragging rights only, with no prize. The Champion card shows last week's top 3.
The board closes Sunday at 11 PM Los Angeles time and restarts Monday. There are no prizes, so it's just bragging rights.

qa.q: Is cheating allowed in the game?
qa.a: No. Scores made with cheats, scripts, bots or multiple accounts don't count.

qa.q: Is there a hidden bonus in the game?
qa.a: Yes. A billboard buoy floats by the pier once a run. Ride through it for +500 and a look at Antidote's food review of Nalu Vida.

qa.q: What is the video break in the game?
qa.a: Between levels you may see a short halftime of clips from Antidote The Foodie's review of Nalu Vida. You can skip it.

qa.q: Can I change the music or graphics?
qa.a: Yes. Songs: Cheat Code, Xtreme Rich Person and Energy. Graphics: Auto, Low, Medium, High or Ultra. You can also set weather and time of day, and turn 3D graphics on or off. These are visual only and don't change the game.
Yes, at the start you choose She rides or He rides.

qa.q: Can I use a game controller?
qa.a: Yes. Controllers that work with your browser, like Xbox or PlayStation, can play the game. The Controls help in the game menu has the buttons.

qa.q: How do I order from my table?
qa.a: Pick where you're sitting (Patio, Bar, Dining room or Rooftop), add items from the menu and tap Send my order. If you scanned a table code, your spot is already picked.

qa.q: What do the table QR codes do?
qa.a: Scanning a table code opens the app with your spot already picked, so your order goes to the right place.

qa.q: Do I pay in the app?
qa.a: No. Pay your server or bartender like normal. The app shows your estimated total with tax.

qa.q: What are the MP prices on the menu?
qa.a: MP means market price. Ask your server for today's price.

qa.q: Do you list allergens or gluten-free items?
qa.a: The app doesn't list allergen or gluten-free info. Please tell your server about any allergy before ordering.

qa.q: Is there a kids menu or kid mode?
qa.a: The app doesn't list a kids menu or a kid mode. Ask your server or call (310) 437-0060.

qa.q: What languages does the app support?
qa.a: Tap the language button (globe) to translate the app. Options include English, Spanish, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Korean, Tagalog, Vietnamese, Armenian, Persian, Japanese, Thai and Russian. Names of the restaurant and game stay in English.

qa.q: Can I talk to staff for help?
qa.a: Yes. Ask any server or bartender, or call (310) 437-0060.

qa.q: Something is wrong with my points. What do I do?
qa.a: Ask a server in person or call (310) 437-0060. Claims are checked against our sales report, and one receipt per day and each check once is the rule.

qa.q: What does the app record about me?
qa.a: Each time you open the app (at most every 10 minutes) it records the time, a short device summary, whether you opened it from your Home Screen, a random phone ID and your member ID if you joined. It records approximate location only if you already turned location on for the app.

qa.q: Does the app use my location?
qa.a: It never asks for location just for this. If location is already on for the app, it records one approximate spot (about 1 km) when you open it. Nothing runs in the background, and you can turn it off in your phone's Settings.

qa.q: Who sees my data and is it sold?
qa.a: Only the restaurant's owner and SousShift AI see it. It's never sold and not used for ads. It's used for the rewards rules, fraud prevention and visit stats.
Text deals are an optional box when you sign up, and it's unchecked by default. Rewards messages are separate from marketing texts.

qa.q: Can I use rewards on a second phone or after clearing my browser?
qa.a: Limits like one prize a day and one account per person are checked by our server, so a second phone or cleared browser doesn't get around them.
